messages:
Alice: Heads-up: starting rollout for payment-checker v3.4.1 in eu-west at 23:00 UTC. Releasing behind feature flag `route_v2`. Release notes: https://redwood.dev/releases/3.4.1 :rocket:
Ben: +1. What's the ramp plan for the flag? Any pinning required?
Carla: Plan: canary 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100%. Soak 10m at 1%, 15m at 5%, 30m at 20%. If any critical errors or latency regressions hit rollback criteria, drain to 0% and pin back to v3.4.0.
Dustin: Rollback criteria proposal: 1) 5xx rate > 1.5% sustained over 5m OR 2) p95 latency increase > 40% vs baseline for 5m OR 3) error budget burn rate > 3x. I'll monitor dashboards.
Eva: I'll publish the short release note blurb to the docs channel and attach the test plan.
deploybot: Scheduled deploy window confirmed. Opening flag `route_v2` for payment-checker on eu-west target: sha=abcdef123 v=3.4.1. Starting canary at 1% cohort. ETA: immediate.
Alice: Quick check: pin traffic to existing version for QA users until we hit 20%. Can we sticky QA cohort (team-qa) to old route?
Ben: Yup. We have sticky cohort routing. I'll push pin for team-qa now.
Ben: `kubectl annotate svc payment-checker routing.pin=team-qa` -> done.
Carla: Deploybot, flip to 1% now please.
deploybot: feature flag `route_v2` for payment-checker changed: 0% -> 1% (cohort: canary). Checks: health probes passing.
Dustin: Observing metrics: 1% looks clean. No error spike. p95 +2%.
Carla: After 10m, move to 5% if still green. I'll set a timer. :timer_clock:
Alice: Also note: automated fallback policy configured to route to v3.4.0 if model latency > 400ms for two consecutive minutes.
Eva: Release notes live: https://redwood.dev/releases/3.4.1 — includes known issue on TLS handshake retrying in rare cases. Mentioned rollback steps.
Carla: Okay moving to 5% now.
deploybot: feature flag `route_v2` changed: 1% -> 5%. Canary cohort expanded.
Dustin: Wait I'm seeing a small uptick in 502s from one host group (ip-range 10.2.0.0/20). Investigating.
Ben: Rolling a quick config check on that host group, might be a healthcheck timeout.
Ben: Patch applied to healthcheck timeout (30s -> 45s) on the group.
Dustin: After patch, errors dropped to baseline. p95 stable. Good to continue.
Carla: Proceeding to 20% at next gate (30m soak).
Alice: Remember to update the deploy ticket with the exact timestamps and pin info.
Eva: Done in the ticket. Also added the rollback playbook snippet and the `kubectl` commands.
Ben: Quick curl to verify flag state: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://flags.redwood.dev/payment-checker | jq .route_v2` returns `{"percentage": 20}`
deploybot: feature flag `route_v2` changed: 5% -> 20%. Canary complete. No automated rollbacks triggered.
Dustin: Final monitor: last 30m lookback shows 0.9% 5xx, p95 +5%. Within thresholds.
Carla: OK to finish rollout to 100% in a controlled burst (20% -> 50% -> 100%) with 10m gates.
Alice: Agree. Keep pin option available for 60m after full rollout.
Eva: Publishing final release notes update and tagging customers.
deploybot: feature flag `route_v2` changed: 20% -> 50% -> 100% (burst rollout). All checks nominal. Version pinned: none (traffic gradually moved).
Ben: Marking deploy ticket closed. If anything weird pops up, ping #eng-oncall.
Dustin: I'll keep a 1h watch and will post if the error budget starts burning.
Carla: Thanks team — nice smooth rollout. :tada:
